name: elasticache
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS ElastiCache cluster (Redis, Valkey, or Memcached).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this ElastiCache cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the ElastiCache cluster.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this ElastiCache cluster belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: engine
attributes.description: Cache engine: Redis, Valkey, or Memcached.

attributes.name: engine_version
attributes.description: Engine version (e.g. 7.1). Required unless restoring from a snapshot; when unset and not restoring, the server selects a default.

attributes.name: cache_node_type
attributes.description: Node instance type, e.g. cache.t4g.micro. Data tiering requires an r6gd.* type.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port the cache listens on. Defaults to 6379 (Redis/Valkey) or 11211 (Memcached) when unset.

attributes.name: cluster_mode
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey cluster mode: Disabled (single shard) or Enabled (sharded). Not applicable to Memcached.

attributes.name: num_cache_clusters
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey cluster-mode-disabled: number of nodes (primary + replicas), 1-6. Required for cluster_mode=Disabled; not valid for Memcached or cluster_mode=Enabled.

attributes.name: num_node_groups
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey cluster-mode-enabled: number of shards (node groups), 1-90. Required for cluster_mode=Enabled.

attributes.name: replicas_per_node_group
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey cluster-mode-enabled: replicas per shard, 0-5. Required for cluster_mode=Enabled.

attributes.name: num_cache_nodes
attributes.description: Memcached: number of cache nodes, 1-40. Required when engine=Memcached; not valid for Redis/Valkey.

attributes.name: az_mode
attributes.description: Memcached availability-zone placement: single-az or cross-az. Server-defaulted from the node count when unset.

attributes.name: preferred_availability_zones
attributes.description: Memcached: preferred availability zones for the cache nodes.

attributes.name: node_group_configuration
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey cluster-mode-enabled: per-shard configuration. When provided, length must equal num_node_groups.

attributes.name: node_group_id
attributes.description: Shard (node group) identifier.

attributes.name: slots
attributes.description: Keyspace slot range for this shard, e.g. 0-5461.

attributes.name: primary_availability_zone
attributes.description: Availability zone for the shard's primary node.

attributes.name: replica_availability_zones
attributes.description: Availability zones for the shard's replicas.

attributes.name: replica_count
attributes.description: Number of replicas in this shard.

attributes.name: transit_encryption_enabled
attributes.description: Enable in-transit (TLS) encryption. Must be true when auth_token is set.

attributes.name: auth_token
attributes.description: Redis/Valkey AUTH token. Requires transit_encryption_enabled = true.

attributes.name: auto_minor_version_upgrade
attributes.description: Automatically apply minor engine version upgrades.

attributes.name: data_tiering_enabled
attributes.description: Enable data tiering (Redis/Valkey on r6gd.* node types only).

attributes.name: preferred_maintenance_window
attributes.description: Weekly maintenance window, e.g. sun:05:00-sun:06:00.

attributes.name: snapshot_retention_limit
attributes.description: Days to retain automatic snapshots (Redis/Valkey). 0 disables automatic snapshots. Not applicable to Memcached, where the server leaves it unset; the server value is retained when omitted.

attributes.name: snapshot_window
attributes.description: Daily window for automatic snapshots, e.g. 03:00-04:00 (Redis/Valkey).

attributes.name: parameters
attributes.description: Cache parameter overrides applied to the parameter group. When omitted, the server's current parameter set is retained (the API returns an empty list rather than null).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Parameter name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Parameter value.

attributes.name: log_delivery_configurations
attributes.description: Log delivery configurations (Redis/Valkey slow-log / engine-log).

attributes.name: log_type
attributes.description: Log type: slow-log or engine-log.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Destination type: cloudwatch-logs or kinesis-firehose.

attributes.name: destination
attributes.description: Destination name (log group or delivery stream).

attributes.name: log_format
attributes.description: Log format: text or json.

attributes.name: snapshot_name
attributes.description: Name of a snapshot to restore from (Redis/Valkey). Mutually exclusive with snapshot_arns.

attributes.name: snapshot_arns
attributes.description: S3 ARNs of an RDB snapshot to restore from (Redis/Valkey). Mutually exclusive with snapshot_name.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this cluster to a cloud provider account. Inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: cache_subnet_group_name
attributes.description: Cache subnet group. Derived from the resource group's network.

attributes.name: security_group_ids
attributes.description: Security group IDs. Derived from the resource group.

attributes.name: encryption_mode
attributes.description: At-rest encryption mode: NoEncryption, ResourceGroupKmsKey (uses the resource group's KMS key), or AwsDefaultElastiCacheKey.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ARN for at-rest encryption. Derived from the resource group when encryption_mode = ResourceGroupKmsKey.

attributes.name: multi_az_enabled
attributes.description: Whether Multi-AZ is enabled. Derived from the cluster topology.

attributes.name: automatic_failover_enabled
attributes.description: Whether automatic failover is enabled. Derived from the cluster topology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: configuration_endpoint
attributes.description: Configuration endpoint (cluster-mode-enabled Redis/Valkey and Memcached).

attributes.name: primary_endpoint
attributes.description: Primary endpoint address (Redis/Valkey).

attributes.name: reader_endpoint
attributes.description: Reader endpoint address (Redis/Valkey).

attributes.name: auth_token_secret_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the AUTH token.

attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: Provisioned CloudFormation stack identifier.

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
